verdict.rationale: Elicit is built to generate AI insights from a user's own papers. Chat can compare, summarize and cluster papers in the user's collection. The Research Agent adds extraction columns, generates figures and research reports, and Routines write summaries. Imported Zotero/RIS/PDF libraries feed automated screening recommendations and extraction, with source quotes highlighted. One hands-on user confirmed fast, cited topic insights, but other hands-on reports describe incorrect summaries and invented facts, which affects reliability rather than whether the capability exists. Missing for 10: consistent independent corroboration of insight accuracy, and clearer evidence of proactive (unprompted) suggestions beyond screening recommendations and alerts.
